verdict.rationale: Paychex documents a public REST API with OAuth 2.0, paging, rate limiting and webhooks, covering payroll-adjacent use cases such as check creation and labor distribution. It also advertises robust payroll reporting. That gives an agent a plausible programmatic path to payroll data, but nothing in the evidence specifically shows journal or GL data being retrievable or exportable, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: a documented payroll journal/GL endpoint or export, any ledger/accounting reconciliation or integration path, a machine-readable API spec, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
